title: Hunter 350 Rebel Blue
description: Representing Royal Enfield's prowess in the Performance Cruiser class, the Royal Enfield Hunter 350 Rebel Blue is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 350cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
